sequence.description: The wild-type sequence (no masks), uppercase one-letter codes, at most 1,024 residues.

variants.description: Mutations like A23G (wild type, 1-indexed position, mutant); join several with : for a multi-mutant (scores add).

method.description: masked_marginal (default): each mutated position masked in turn; wildtype_marginal: one pass over the wild type.

structure.description: A protein structure as a PDB file. The first model is read: ATOM records of amino acids (HETATM ignored), one chain, the first alternate location of each atom. N, CA and C are used (at least one residue needs all three). Plain text, UTF-8 or Latin-1; a gzip file is refused.

chain.description: Chain to read from the PDB file (default: the first).
